run_backup: run a full zip backup of the hermes home directory excluding cache and transient files
run_import: import and restore a hermes backup zip file onto the current hermes home directory
create_quick_snapshot: create a quick state snapshot of critical hermes config and database files
list_quick_snapshots: list existing quick state snapshots ordered most recent first
restore_quick_snapshot: restore hermes state files from a previously created quick snapshot
